spans.s: SV0306 वेग vega Derived from Vij- to agitate, to make quickly. The Vega word means in the medical context, natural urges (for elimination), reflex, and excitement. Usually, however it is taken in the sense of natural urges of the body, which call for urgent satisfaction. in Ayurvedic parlance denotes natural reflexes or urges. They are of two types Dharaniya (Suppressible urges) such as Greed, Anger etc and Adhāraṇīya (non suppressible urges) such as Sneezing, Sleep etc.
AF2453 वेग अप्रादुर्भाव vega aprādurbhāva Deprived of reflex
AT0357 वेगान्तर vegāntara Interval between two attacks (impulses) of poison.
